reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the finding correctly reports absence of any audit/inspection/verification right binding the Customer; no redline or comment is expected or provided, and the rendered text is unchanged from the originals.

Cited paragraphs support the compliance conclusion: p0001's 'access, support and cooperation' obligation is a service-delivery cooperation covenant tied to Kubient providing the Services, not an audit or verification right, and p0025 is a use-restriction/compliance covenant restricting Customer from granting third-party access — neither creates frequency, notice, cost or system-access audit exposure.

The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is explained and non-dispositive here: there is no audit clause to carry frequency/notice limits, so the regex heuristic cannot match; absence of the obligation sits at or better than the preferred position for a customer-protective rule.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped; the noted vendor-side verification gap (Impressions measured by Kubient, revenue share based on Kubient's collections) is correctly flagged as out of scope for this customer-facing audit rule rather than used to manufacture a deviation.
